title: Postdoctoral Fellowship Competition
about: SEDarc's 2027/28 Postdoctoral Fellowship Competition asks applicants to upload an expression of interest form and a two-page CV to the SEDarc portal by 23:59 GMT on 15 January 2027. Nominated candidates complete the full ESRC application by 23 March 2027; fellowships start 1 October 2027.
requirements: No more than 12 months of active postdoctoral experience (full-time equivalent, allowing for career breaks)

upskill.name: the full course catalog
why: No Academy course objective covers the stated requirement ("No more than 12 months of active postdoctoral experience") or the field "Social sciences (ESRC)"; shortlist matches were keyword noise ("no", "social"), so the link points to the Academy course catalog, not a specific course.

card_alt: Card for the Postdoctoral Fellowship Competition at SEDarc, United Kingdom, deadline 15 Jan 2027. The photo shows Big Ben and Westminster Bridge in London, an illustrative UK landmark; no host city is specified for the offer.
